newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dadonghai's B share offer priced at HK$1.22 each.
newsitem.headline: Dadonghai's B share offer priced at HK$1.22 each.

text.p: Hainan Dadonghai Tourism Centre (Holdings) Co Ltd said on Monday that it will offer 70 million class B shares on September 17 and list them later on the Shenzhen stock market.
The issue, approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, has been priced at HK$1.22 per share, a company official told the China Securities Bulletin.
The offer has a price/earnings ratio of 6.68 times based on a 1996 projected net profit of 63 million yuan using international accounting standards, the official said.
An underwriting ceremony for the B share offer was held in Shenzhen on Sunday and the B share offer prospectus will be published on September 17.
Shanghai Guotai Securities has been appointed domestic lead underwriter for the issue, with Seapower Securities Ltd the international coordinator, the official said.
Dadonghai, based in the resort of Sanya on Hainan island, aims to use proceeds from the B share offer to renovate a wholly owned subsidiary, South China Sea Grand Hotel.

Before the share offer, Dadonghai had total share capital of 240 million shares. Of these, 101.07 million shares were held by the founders, 108.93 million by institutions and 30 million by employees, the official said.
After the B share listing, Dadonghai plans to apply to the China Securities Regulatory Commission to issue 14 million class A shares, for listing in Shenzhen, he said.
Using Chinese accounting standards, Dadonghai posted about 40 million yuan in net earnings last year, he said, but gave no further details.
